newConcreteFinding.scope: Qualification-controller input provenance, not a proven consensus/signing vulnerability
newConcreteFinding.cause: A public file hash and the JSON object used by the controller come from separate reads. A substituted second version can be parsed after the original hash passed.
newConcreteFinding.newScenario: Public recovery report replacement between hash and parse, changing public restart floor or proof claims. Not covered by the observer23 tests, whose pure interface receives already-parsed checkpoints.
newConcreteFinding.currentRiskBoundary: No source report replacement observed in this campaign. Current physical preparation is externally quiescent. Runtime primary/witness exact commitments still fail closed on a true DB/token mismatch; this finding concerns exact attachment of the controller proof to bytes it actually used.
newConcreteFinding.proposedCorrection: Use a pure/testable one-buffer verified JSON reader: one read, compare external expected SHA, then JSON.parse that same buffer. Apply to hash-pinned reports and other JSON bindings; bind index/preparation through their external pins before parse.
proposedNewTests: A supplied one-shot file provider is invoked only once for accepted input.
Substituted/mismatched bytes refuse before parsing or any writer startup.
Hash-valid bytes with malformed JSON refuse.
Missing/invalid trusted pin refuses; no hash derived from the same untrusted input becomes its own authority.

checkedExistingSafety: Independent primary/witness namespace and token types; frozen current PRIMARY config fix.
Canonical snapshots, exact digest/intent linkage, two cold reopens and before/after byte/inode inventories.
Pending key64 stop identity remains null with public key, even when automatic registry lookup resolves it internally.
Preserved actual monotonic clock limits and finite startup budget.
Strict bootstrap checkpoint option, later headers/ancestry and no404fallback.
Copied source/destination preconditions and stopped writer cleanup.
knownLimitsNotReclassifiedAsNewGaps: Poll deadlines are checked between finite operations, not a hard whole-controller watchdog; already documented.
Capture explicitly does not qualify durable pending-message semantics, full archive BLS/history replay, cold/fragmented formats or live duties.
Observer does not independently hash general block SSZ or perform BLS algebra; already scoped.
